description: §7.6 rule (a): a file-scope initializer that calls a server-placed function is E-FILE-SCOPE-SERVER-ONLY-REACH, annotated or not (#1962 review LOW-2).
rationale: §7.6 rule (a): "An initializer that reaches a server-only resource — … or a call of a server-placed function (§12.2) — SHALL be a compile error, **`E-FILE-SCOPE-SERVER-ONLY-REACH`**"; §20.7.3: a `function` that calls `print` / `println` is server-placed. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 open-Qs item 59 (a).
